race.comment: Good little maiden. YOUMZAA (12) was in the market and ran a very good race on debut at Bendigo, setting up a strong speed and doing well to hold second. The winner there is talented and has won a G3 race nicely since, with natural upside she'll be very hard to run down. GHANA'S AKAN (9) also brings Over The Bridge form having run behind her in said G3 race. She's won of the better maidens going around and provided she's got a bit more left in the tank she'll go close. SEE THREE PEE OH (6) is a gelding by Cosmic Force on debut for the Stokes yard who can run well off a nice trial win. OPTIMUS (15) showed some ability in two runs last time in and looks an improver.
